claims.text: Banglapedia distinguishes Company revenue rights from Nawab nizamat and later direct revenue assumption. British Library catalogues describe Dacca and Patna revenue-council holdings, not inspected decisions. Dhaka’s municipal account separates magistracy from municipality. Shared revenue authority does not make these local functions identical or establish total sovereignty.
